_: HOW THE COLLEGE IS REACHED, AND WHERE IT PUBLICLY IS.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Three social icons — LinkedIn, Instagram, X —
sat in the topbar, the mobile drawer and the footer of every page
on this site, in both languages, each of them linking to `#`. Six
dead controls on 169 routes. The link census could not see them:
`#` resolves to the page you are already on, so nothing reported a
broken link, and they were invisible in the source because they
looked exactly like the real thing.
A dead social icon is not a small fault. It is an implied claim —
that the College keeps an account there — placed in the chrome of
every page, and CLAUDE.md § 5 is explicit: silence about a thing
the College does not have is fine; a claim is not.
THE RULE. `social` is rendered from this file and from nowhere
else. An empty object renders NOTHING — no row, no icons, no
placeholder. Add a key with a real URL and the icon appears in the
topbar, the mobile drawer and the footer at once, in both
languages. Adding a key with an empty or `#` value is refused by
scripts/build.js rather than rendered, because that is the exact
fault this file was written to close.
Recognised keys are the ones the icon sprite has marks for:
linkedin, instagram, x. A fourth platform needs a symbol in
partials/icons.html first — an icon-less link in a row of icons is
a worse answer than no link.
